IDiscussionBoardDiscussionBoardMember.description:
Representation of a registered member in the discussion board system.

Includes identification, contact details, account status, assigned role, and lifecycle timestamps.

Excludes sensitive authentication data such as password hashes for security.

Members are authenticated users authorized to post articles and comments.

id.description: Unique identifier assigned to the member, generated automatically upon registration.

email.description: Email address associated with the member account, used for authentication and communication.

nickname.description: Display name used throughout the discussion board to identify the member.

oneOf.description: Indicates the member account is active and in good standing.
Indicates the member account has been banned and is restricted from participation.
Indicates the member account is pending verification or approval.

status.description: Current status of the member account, reflecting its availability and restrictions.

role.description: Designated role of the member within the discussion board, determining permissions and access level. Typical roles include user, moderator, or admin.

created_at.description: Timestamp recording when the member registered with the discussion board.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of the latest update to the member’s profile or account information.

IDiscussionBoardDiscussionBoardMember.IC.description:
Request schema for creating a new registered member in the discussion board.

Includes the unique email for authentication, a plain text password that will be hashed server-side, and display nickname.

Excludes authentication identity fields derived from JWT tokens.

All fields are mandatory for successful registration.

email.description: Unique email address used for login and communication. Must be unique among all members of the discussion board.

password.description: Plain text password input from client for registration. Backend will handle secure hashing before storage.

nickname.description: Display nickname chosen by the member for identification in the discussion board community.

IDiscussionBoardDiscussionBoardMember.IU.description:
Request schema for updating an existing member's profile.

Allows modification of the email address, plain text password (to be hashed server-side), and nickname. 

Ownership and timestamps are managed internally and are not part of this schema.

All fields are optional, allowing partial updates.

email.description: The updated email address of the member. Must maintain uniqueness and a valid format.

password.description: Plain text password input for updating member authentication. Backend will hash before storage.

nickname.description: Updated display nickname for member identification in the discussion board.

discussion_board_member_id.description: Unique identifier of the discussion board member for filtering sessions.

pagination.description: Pagination information to control result pages.

sort.description: Sorting order of session records based on timestamp or other criteria.

IDiscussionBoardMemberSessions.IRequest.description: Request schema for searching and filtering discussion board member sessions. Supports pagination and sorting.

id.description: Unique identifier of the session.

discussion_board_member_id.description: Identifier of the member owning this session.

ip.description: IP address from which the session originated.

href.description: Full URL of the connection request.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the session was created.

expired_at.description: Datetime when the session expires or null if the session is active.

IDiscussionBoardMemberSessions.description: Detailed information about an active session for a registered discussion board member.

IDiscussionBoardAdmin.IRequest.description:
Request type for searching and filtering discussion board administrator accounts with pagination support.

Supports complex search criteria including filtering by email, nickname, creation and deletion timestamps.

Ensures efficient admin list retrieval and respects security controls limiting access to authorized users.

page.description: Page number for paginated queries, starting at 1.

limit.description: Maximum number of administrators to return per page, controlling page size.

search.description: General search string applicable to multiple administrator fields such as email or nickname.

email.description: Filter administrators by exact email match to pinpoint specific accounts.

nickname.description: Filter administrators using nickname to retrieve users with matching or similar display names.

created_at_from.description: Filter administrators created on or after this timestamp for temporal queries.

created_at_to.description: Filter administrators created on or before this timestamp for temporal queries.

deleted_at_is_null.description: Filter to include only active administrators when true (deleted_at is null).

IDiscussionBoardAdmin.description:
Represents a system administrator with full permissions to manage the discussion board and its users.

This entity includes authentication credentials and administrative metadata used to control access and track state changes within the system.

Properties include unique email credentials, nickname, and timestamps for auditing creation, updates, and soft deletion.

The sensitive hashed password is removed from the response for security.

id.description: Unique identifier for the discussion board administrator.

email.description: Email address for administrator login and communication. Must be unique among all discussion board admins.

nickname.description: Display name of the discussion board administrator user.

created_at.description: Timestamp marking when the administrator record was first created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp marking the most recent update to the administrator record.

deleted_at.description: Soft deletion timestamp. Null indicates the administrator account is active.

IDiscussionBoardAdmin.ICreate.description:
Schema for creating a new discussion board administrator user account.

Includes required user input fields such as unique email, plaintext password, and nickname.

Passwords are supplied as plaintext and must be hashed securely on the server before storage.

System-managed fields like id and timestamps are excluded from this schema.

All fields are required to ensure a valid new administrator account setup.

email.description: Unique email address to identify the new administrator account.

password.description: Plaintext password to be securely hashed by the backend before storing.

nickname.description: Preferred display name for the new administrator user.

discussionBoardAdminId.description: Unique identifier of the target discussion board administrator

page.description: Page number for pagination, starting from 1

sortBy.description: Field name to sort the results by

oneOf.description: Sort order: ascending or descending
Sort order: ascending or descending

startDate.description: Filter sessions starting after this timestamp

endDate.description: Filter sessions ending before this timestamp

IDiscussionBoardAdminSession.IRequest.description: Parameters for searching, filtering, sorting, and paginating discussion board administrator sessions. Includes filters by creation time range and keyword search. Pagination, sorting options facilitate efficient data browsing.

IDiscussionBoardAdminSession.description:
Discussion board administrator session record, capturing authentication and audit information with IP, connection and referrer URLs, start and optional expiration timestamps.

Linked to an admin user via foreign key discussion_board_admin_id not exposed in this DTO.

Used in response bodies for session operations.

id.description: Unique identifier of the session.

discussion_board_admin_id.description: Identifier of the associated discussion board administrator.

ip.description: IP address from which the session originated.

href.description: Connection URL where the session was established.

referrer.description: Referrer URL showing the previous page before connection.

created_at.description: Timestamp marking when the session was created.

expired_at.description: Timestamp marking when the session expired; null if still active.

IDiscussionBoardAdminSession.ICreate.description:
Request body schema for creating a discussion board administrator session record.

Includes connection IP address, URL, referrer, and timestamps.
The session is linked to an administrator via context and thus excludes admin_id in request since it is injected from authenticated actor context.

ip.description: IP address of the connection origin.

href.description: Connection URL where the session is initiated.

referrer.description: Referrer URL indicating the previous page URL before connection.

expired_at.description: Optional expiration date/time of the session; null indicates an active session.

IDiscussionBoardAdminSession.IUpdate.description:
Request body schema for updating a discussion board administrator session record.

Allows updating connection details and expiration of the session.
Admin identifier is handled by authentication context and thus excluded from request.
All fields are optional to support partial updates.

ip.description: IP address of the connection origin.

href.description: Connection URL where the session is initiated.

referrer.description: Referrer URL indicating the previous page URL before connection.

expired_at.description: Optional expiration date/time of the session; null indicates an active session.

IDiscussionBoardArticles.IRequest.description:
Request body schema for searching and filtering discussion board articles.

Includes pagination parameters, search keywords, sorting options, and filters by author or categories.

Used in POST /discussionBoard/member/discussionBoardArticles (PATCH method) to retrieve filtered article lists.

page.description: Page number for pagination; starting at 1.

limit.description: Maximum number of articles to retrieve per page.

search.description: Full-text search query to find articles containing the specified keywords.

sortBy.description: Field by which to sort the articles, e.g., 'created_at', 'title'.

oneOf.description: Direction of sorting: ascending or descending.
Direction of sorting: ascending or descending.

sortDirection.description: Direction of sorting: ascending or descending.

authorId.description: Filter articles authored by the specified member ID.

categoryIds.description: List of category IDs to filter articles belonging to these categories.

IDiscussionBoardAttachment.ICreate.description: Attachment creation payload for adding a new file or image to a discussion board article. This schema requires specifying the attachment type ('image' or 'file'), the URL to the stored resource, and the original filename. All fields are required to ensure integrity and proper linkage to the article.

Type of attachment, either 'image' or 'file' to distinguish the media format.

type.description: Type of attachment, either 'image' or 'file' to distinguish the media format.

filename.description: Original name of the uploaded file for identification and display purposes.

IDiscussionBoardAttachment.description: Detailed information of a discussion board attachment associated with an article, including type, URL, and filename.

id.description: Unique identifier of the attachment.

discussionBoardArticleId.description: UUID of the related article that this attachment belongs to.

oneOf.description: Type of attachment, either an image or a file.
Type of attachment, either an image or a file.

url.description: URL pointing to the location of the attachment resource.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the attachment was created.

IDiscussionBoardAttachment.IUpdate.description:
Schema for updating an existing attachment of a discussion board article.

This type is used for updating attachment metadata such as type, URL, and filename associated with a specific article. The authenticated user must be the owner or authorized party related to the article or attachment.

Certain system fields like created_at, updated_at are managed automatically and should not be provided by clients.

Actor identity fields are excluded, as those are automatically injected from authentication context.

type.description: Attachment type indicating whether this is an image or other file. Valid values: 'image', 'file'.

url.description: URL path to the stored attachment resource.

filename.description: Original name of the uploaded file.

IDiscussionBoardComment.IRequest.description:
Search criteria and pagination parameters for filtering discussion board comments.

Allows clients to filter comments by associated article, author, content keywords, dates, sorting, and pagination parameters. Supports complex searching while respecting user authorization.

This DTO enables efficient browsing and moderation of comments within the discussion board system.

discussion_board_article_id.description: Filter comments by the UUID of the associated discussion board article.

discussion_board_member_id.description: Filter comments by the UUID of the member author.

content.description: Filter comments by matching text content keywords.

created_at_start.description: Filter comments created on or after this date-time.

created_at_end.description: Filter comments created before this date-time.

page.description: Page number for pagination. Defaults to 1.

limit.description: Maximum number of items per page. Defaults and maximums enforced server-side.

sort_by.description: Field to sort results by, e.g., 'created_at' or 'updated_at'.

oneOf.description: Sort order direction, either 'asc' or 'desc'.
Sort order direction, either 'asc' or 'desc'.

IDiscussionBoardComment.description:
Represents a user comment on an article in the economic and political discussion board.

This entity includes immutable identifier fields, content text, reference to the author and article, timestamps for creation, update, and optional soft deletion.
Foreign key fields are replaced with referenced objects for atomic read operations.

Authorization is enforced to ensure only the author modifies their own comments.

id.description: Unique identifier of the comment.

content.description: Text content of the comment, supporting the discussion without attachments.

discussion_board_article_id.description: Foreign key identifier referencing the article this comment belongs to. Maintained for database integrity, but clients should use article references in requests.

author.description: The member who authored this comment, providing context and identity information.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the comment was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the comment was last updated.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp for soft deletion; null if not deleted.

content.description: Text content of the comment, supporting the discussion without attachments

discussion_board_article_id.description: Reference to the article being commented on

ip.description: Client IP address for session tracking (OPTIONAL - server can extract, but client may provide for SSR)

IDiscussionBoardComment.ICreate.description:
Create a new discussion board comment to an article.

This operation allows authenticated users to post textual comments linked to specific articles on the discussion board. The request body must include the comment content and reference to the article ID.

Security: Authentication context provides the member ID automatically and MUST NOT be included in this DTO.

IDiscussionBoardDiscussionBoardMember.IS.description:
Summary representation of a registered member within the discussion board system.

This type provides a concise view with critical member information suitable for list views, summaries, and as a reference within other entities.

Sensitive authentication fields such as password hashes are excluded in this summary.

Includes unique identifier, email, and chosen nickname for display.

id.description: Unique identifier of the member.

email.description: Email address of the member used for authentication and contact.

nickname.description: Chosen display nickname of the member.

IDiscussionBoardMemberSessions.ISummary.description:
Summary information of active sessions for registered discussion board members.

Provides essential session details such as session ID, IP address, connection URL, and referrer, used for audit and monitoring purposes.

Intended for lightweight list views where detailed member info is not required.

id.description: Unique identifier for the member session.

ip.description: IP address from which the member session originated.

href.description: Full URL of the connection request associated with this session.

referrer.description: HTTP referrer URL from the member's session connection.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the session was created.

expired_at.description: Timestamp when the session expires. Null means the session is active and has no expiration.

IDiscussionBoardAdmin.ISummary.description:
Summary representation of an administrator in the discussion board system.

Includes identification, login email, display nickname, and timestamps.

Used primarily for list views and embeddings where full admin details are not necessary.

id.description: Unique identifier of the administrator.

email.description: Email address for administrator login and communication. Unique among admins.

nickname.description: Display name for the administrator user.

deleted_at.description: Soft deletion timestamp; null means active.

IDiscussionBoardAdminSession.ISummary.description:
Summary of an active administrator session, providing essential session details for display and audit purposes.

Represents a lightweight view of administrator session with key properties.

Includes identifier and connection metadata.

id.description: Unique identifier of the administrator session.

discussion_board_admin_id.description: Identifier of the administrator who owns this session.

ip.description: IP address from which the administrator connected during session.

href.description: URL that the administrator accessed to establish the session.

referrer.description: Referrer URL from which the administrator navigated before the session start.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the session was started.

expired_at.description: Timestamp when the session expired, or null if session is still active.

IDiscussionBoardArticles.ISummary.description:
Summary representation of a discussion board article.

Provides key details such as unique article identifier, title, author reference, and timestamps for creation and modification.

Excludes large content fields for performance optimization in list views.

id.description: Unique identifier of the article.

title.description: Title of the article representing its main subject or headline.

discussion_board_member_id.description: Identifier of the member who authored the article.

created_at.description: Timestamp marking when the article was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp marking the most recent update to the article.

IDiscussionBoardComment.ISummary.description:
Summary of a comment in the discussion board.

Provides a lightweight view of a user comment linked to a discussion board article. Includes the comment's unique ID, author information as a summary, textual content, and timestamps indicating creation and last update.

Excludes soft deletion timestamps and detailed audit logs. Used in listing comments with essential reference to the author.

Relationships:
- author: a summarized reference to the member who wrote the comment
- article_id: retained as UUID to identify the parent article

All foreign keys are represented appropriately to avoid exposing sensitive information or requiring clients to supply actor identity fields.

id.description: Unique identifier of the comment.

author.description: Summary information of the member who authored the comment.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the comment was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of the last update to the comment.

discussion_board_article_id.description: Identifier of the article this comment is associated with.

IDiscussionBoardMember.ISummary.description:
Summary representation of a registered member within the discussion board system.

Provides essential identification and profile information for listing and embedding in other entities.

Sensitive information such as passwords and tokens are excluded for security.

Used in lists and references across the discussion board API.

id.description: Unique identifier of the discussion board member.

username.description: Unique username of the member used for login and display.

displayName.description: Display name of the member shown publicly on the discussion board.

avatarUrl.description: URL to the member's avatar image. May be null if no avatar is set.

IDiscussionBoardArticle.ISummary.description:
Summary representation of a discussion board article.

Optimized for list views and abbreviated displays, excluding large content bodies.

Includes key metadata and author reference.

Sensitive or private fields are excluded.

This schema helps reduce payload size and improves performance on listing endpoints.

id.description: Unique identifier of the article.

publishedAt.description: Publication date and time. Null if unpublished.

author.description: Summary information of the article's author.

IDiscussionBoardMemberSession.ICreate.description:
Payload for creating a new authentication session record for a discussion board member.

This schema represents the data required to create a new session, capturing connection details including the IP address, full request URL, HTTP referrer, and timestamps for creation and optional expiry. The discussion_board_member_id is not accepted from client request body as it comes from authentication context and URI path parameter.

ip.description: IP address from which the session originated.

href.description: Full URL of the connection request.

created_at.description: Session creation timestamp in ISO 8601 format.

expired_at.description: Session expiry timestamp in ISO 8601 format; null means session is active.

IDiscussionBoardMemberSession.description:
Represents an authentication session record associated with a discussion board member.

This object captures the session details including connection originating IP, the requested URL, referrer, timestamps for creation and expiration, and which member owns this session.

It is used for authentication management, session validation, and audit logging in the discussion board system.

id.description: Unique identifier of the session record.

discussion_board_member_id.description: Unique identifier of the discussion board member who owns this session.

ip.description: IP address from which the session originated.

href.description: Full URL of the connection request.

created_at.description: Session creation timestamp in ISO 8601 format.

expired_at.description: Session expiry timestamp in ISO 8601 format; null means session is active.

IDiscussionBoardMemberSession.IUpdate.description:
Data type for updating an existing discussion board member session record.

This DTO allows modification of fields such as IP address, connection URLs, timestamps, and the session expiry status,
while excluding immutable or auto-generated fields. It ensures accurate audit logging and session management.

Authentication actor 'member' is derived from JWT context; therefore, member ID fields are excluded from this request.

ip.description: IP address from where the discussion board member session originated. Allows updating for accurate logging of connection source.

href.description: Full URL of the connection request associated with this session to track request origin.

referrer.description: HTTP referrer URL to capture which page led to the current session connection for security context.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the session record was originally created. Immutable field typically not changed in updates.

updated_at.description: Timestamp for when the session record was last updated to track modifications.

expired_at.description: Optional timestamp indicating when the session expires. Null indicates an active, non-expired session.

IDiscussionBoardAdmin.IUpdate.description:
Request DTO for updating properties of an existing discussion board administrator.

Supports modification of email, nickname, and soft deletion status, where applicable.

Fields such as the password hash and timestamps are managed internally and thus omitted from client update requests.

Email uniqueness is enforced to prevent duplication.

email.description: Updated email address for administrator login. Must remain unique.

nickname.description: New display name for the administrator user.

deleted_at.description: Soft deletion timestamp to mark account as deleted or restored. Null indicates active status.

IDiscussionBoardArticle.description:
Detailed schema for a discussion board article.

Represents an article posted by a registered member with title, content, author reference, and timestamps.

Used in GET /discussionBoard/discussionBoardArticles/{id}, and in creation and update responses.

id.description: Unique identifier of the article.

content.description: Main content body of the article.

discussion_board_member_id.description: UUID of the member who authored the article.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the article was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the article was last updated.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp for soft deletion; null if not deleted.

IDiscussionBoardArticle.ICreate.description:

This schema strictly matches the discussion_board_articles Prisma model fields for creation.

title.description: Title of the discussion board article. Required field representing the main headline of the article.

content.description: Content body of the article, supporting rich formatted text and discussion.

IDiscussionBoardArticle.IUpdate.description:
Request schema for updating a discussion board article.

Allows modification of the title and content fields only. Other properties such as author and timestamps are immutable and excluded from update requests.

This schema strictly matches the discussion_board_articles Prisma model fields for updates.

title.description: Updated title of the article. Optional property when updating.

content.description: Updated content of the article. Optional property when updating.

IDiscussionBoardGuest.ISummary.description:
Summary view of a guest user in the discussion board, providing lightweight identification suitable for listings and embedded references.

This type includes only essential information that represents the guest user without sensitive or detailed attributes.

Used for displaying guest user references in other entities and lists.

id.description: Unique identifier of the guest user.

nickname.description: Display nickname of the guest user.

IDiscussionBoardAttachment.ISummary.description:
Summary of discussion board attachment entity.

Represents a condensed view of an attachment associated with a discussion board article. This summary includes essential fields such as the attachment's unique identifier, type (image or file), filename, and URL.
